name: Flail Chest
definition: Segmental fractures of multiple consecutive ribs creating an unstable chest-wall segment, often associated with pulmonary contusion and respiratory failure.
differentials: Multiple rib fractures without flail segment

investigations.principle: CT chest is commonly used in major trauma to characterize injuries.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Ventilatory support or surgical rib fixation is selected according to respiratory status and injury pattern.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Emergency respiratory/trauma care takes priority over any traditional framework.

patientEducation.summary: Segmental fractures of multiple consecutive ribs creating an unstable chest-wall segment, often associated with pulmonary contusion and respiratory failure.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
